scope: owned VM test infrastructure failure before Engine OS boot
initial_hypothesis: The optional display was suspected because VMware crashed after initializing VNC.
confirmed_followup: The same startup crash occurred with VNC disabled. The owned hypervisor log explicitly reported no PCIe slot available for Ethernet0 and failure to register e1000e. The minimal hand-written fixture lacked a PCIe root port.
correction: Add a standard PCIe root port to the owned VM profile before testing the PCIe adapter. No Engine OS boot success or VNC runtime success is claimed by these failed attempts.
